$comment: WORLD MODULE: organizations and geography — the exogenous drivers (pack: common).

legalStructure.$note: ESTIMATE — bizapps-common's OrganizationType is LEGAL STRUCTURE, orthogonal to our business Type (a creamery can be an LLC or a partnership). That FK sat NULL on all 641 organizations, so the column rendered blank in their org grids. Names are the app's own seeded values (finding F6) — 'Educational Institution' and 'Sole Proprietorship' carry spaces.

orgs.$note: lifecycle events (dissolved/acquired/program-cut) feed arrow 1.15 and the Anna/Bob/Danielle-class churn stories

geography.$note: cities carry pre-baked coordinates (GAP-11a); dairy-belt weighting inside NA

contacts.$note: ESTIMATE — contact methods and addresses are FIRST-CLASS rows in bizapps-common (ContactMethod, Address, AddressLink), which owns the domain. MemberProfile keeps its denormalised copy for segmentation; these rows are what the app's own UI reads. Types are referenced BY NAME — bizapps-common seeds them (finding F6).

prospects.$note: ESTIMATE — non-members the federation knows: enquiries, free-webinar attendees, colleagues of members. A Person with NO MemberProfile (the v2 identity/membership split already models this). Conversion to membership and paid non-member pricing are deliberately out of scope for this pass. Sized so the people who came and did NOT join outnumber the ones who did — the denominator is the whole point.

funnel.$note: ESTIMATE — the BEFORE half of membership. Recent joiners get the pre-membership history they would have had (a free webinar or two, an application) so a conversion rate is computable WITHOUT adding a single member: the roster is untouched, only its prologue is filled in. knownBeforeJoiningShare is deliberately small: most members arrive without a traceable prior touch, and a webinar-to-member rate in the teens is what association benchmarks report — 70% would mean the webinar list WAS the member list.
